The '''''Outward Bound''''' was a modified [[Vangaard Industries]] [[Pathfinder-class scout ship|Pathfinder]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] that was owned by the [[Cyrs family]]. Over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was handed down through generations of the family and it underwent numerous overhauls and upgrades. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Outward Bound'' was operated by [[Jobany Cyrs]], a freelance [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who was employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Cyrs developed a strong emotional attachment to the vessel and he considered it to be a family heirloom.
